summary: Frontend-only regression + new-module verification for all 12 training modules. Dashboard shows 12/12 READY with no LOCKED cards. All 10 newly implemented modules (Table Reading, Vigilance, Rapid Tracking, Situational Awareness, Spatial Integration, Trace Test, Verbal Logic, Auditory Capacity, Dynamic Projection, Sensory Motor) load without JS errors, render the expected CBT-style UI (dark red title bar, warning/clock strip, red-header panels, bevel borders), expose the documented data-testids, and are interactive. Regression: System Logic and Cognitive Updating still route/render; Admin Settings page loads with both configurable module sections + Save/Reset/Clear buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: Vigilance.handleRespond mutates target.responded directly on the state object inside a setBlips updater - works but is anti-pattern (mutation of state); consider replacing with immutable map.
cbtCommon.js has `import React from 'react'` declared after export statements at line 23 - unusual placement, works in bundlers but non-idiomatic; move to top of file.
TableReading.handleAnswer generates the next question from same static grid; if grid is small the same (r,c) can repeat consecutively (minor UX).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 modules verified via /module/<id> routes. Test data-testids used: practice-mode-btn, difficulty-easy-btn, start-test-btn, cell-R-C, answer-N, radar-display, respond-btn, tracking-area, sa-map, aircraft-*, study-timer, orig-shape, trace-area, vl-prompt, play-audio-btn, dp-area, emerge-btn, sm-area, light-left/right, react-left/right-btn. SituationalAwareness study period ~8s before questions appear. AuditoryCapacity speech synthesis not testable in headless. Admin page uses CSS uppercase transform (inner_text may report uppercase); Cognitive Updating and System Logic sections both render along with SAVE/RESET/CLEAR buttons.
